episodes.title: 21 giorni
episodes.summary: Tensions between rival gangs erupt while crime lord Samurai pulls politicians' strings. Three young crooks ally to seize an opportunity.

episodes.title: Patrizi e plebei
episodes.summary: Samurai sinks his hooks into idealistic Cinaglia. Theodosiou's blackmailers try to silence a witness. Spadino chafes at his looming arranged marriage.

episodes.title: Cani arrabbiati
episodes.summary: Samurai confronts Spadino over Theodosiou and hands Sara a raw deal. Cinaglia finds himself trapped. Manfredi targets Aureliano for revenge.

episodes.title: Buon appetito
episodes.summary: With a brewing war between the Anacletis and Adamis jeopardizing his control over the land deal, Samurai forces Gabriele into a terrible choice.

episodes.title: La lupa
episodes.summary: Livia and Aureliano vie for power. Samurai confronts Sara about her ploy. Spadino's secret complicates his wedding night.

episodes.title: Ajo, oio e peperoncino
episodes.summary: Aureliano forces Sara into a deal, but she schemes to turn the tables. Cinaglia plays strong-arm politics. Theodosiou makes a desperate decision.

episodes.title: Ultimo cliente
episodes.summary: Samurai closes in as Sara tries to avert a Vatican scandal in return for the commission's votes. Livia reacts to Manfredi's move on her territory.

episodes.title: Un altro
episodes.summary: Scrambling to salvage the deal, Samurai summons Livia and Manfredi to a meeting. Sara faces a deception. Angelica discovers Spadino's secret.

episodes.title: Il buio
episodes.summary: Cinaglia doubles down on his political gamble, and Aureliano suffers a dangerous betrayal. Enthused over making a stand, Spadino takes a big risk.

episodes.title: Chiamalo dormire
episodes.summary: Samurai drops the hammer, but Aureliano and Livia resist. Spadino takes charge, Cinaglia charts his future, and Gabriele faces a crisis of conscience.

episodes.title: Trovatela
episodes.summary: While Cinaglia awaits his political campaign's results, Samurai reasserts his control over Aureliano and Lele. Spadino makes a cunning play for power.

episodes.title: Conseguenze
episodes.summary: Livia becomes a pawn -- and a target -- in the clash between Spadino and his mom. Sara seeks a new Vatican ally, and Cinaglia risks disobeying Samurai.

episodes.title: Più vicino
episodes.summary: Aureliano vows revenge. Angelica forms a plan to help Spadino. Cristiana's suspicions about Lele grow. Samurai pressures Sara to relocate the refugees.

episodes.title: A testa in giù
episodes.summary: After Cinaglia's defection, he and Samurai face the fallout. Adelaide moves to control Ostia's drug trade. Lele asks Sara to help him conquer Samurai.

episodes.title: La culla
episodes.summary: While Cinaglia schemes, Samurai seeks to gain a new ally -- and silence an old one. Aureliano turns ruthless to regain control of Ostia's underworld.

episodes.title: È guerra
episodes.summary: New allegiances form, old ones collapse and blood is spilled as drug-turf tensions send Ostia down the path of war.

episodes.title: Santi Pietro e Paolo
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of violence, Cinaglia doubles down on his ruthless plan, Aureliano and Spadino make a deal, and Lele faces the wrath of Samurai.

episodes.title: Dimmi la verità
episodes.summary: As the election nears and Samurai loses his grip on power, Aureliano leans on Nadia for help, Spadino faces blackmail, and Lele makes a fateful choice.

episodes.title: Giubileo
episodes.summary: Samurai, Cinaglia and Badali scheme to cash in on the Vatican's Jubilee celebration while Spadino forms a chilling plan to pull Cinaglia's strings.

episodes.title: Tortura
episodes.summary: Ambitious for yet more power, Aureliano and Spadino consolidate control of their alliance and turn their eyes to new turf: north Rome.

episodes.title: La festa
episodes.summary: Spadino faces a renewed threat to his power. Cinaglia tries to back Cardinal Nascari into a corner. Nadia and Angelica learn the ropes in north Rome.

episodes.title: Il processo
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the shooting, Aureliano and Spadino scramble to salvage their alliance. Cardinal Nascari tries to break Cinaglia's grip on him.

episodes.title: Fratelli
episodes.summary: Discovering the truth, Spadino sets himself on a collision course with Manfredi. Alice comes to a fraught decision about Cinaglia.

episodes.title: Risvegli
episodes.summary: Violence escalates out of control and lives are destroyed as the walls close in around Aureliano, Spadino and those they love.
